When I was sixteen, aka the first time I started to care about politics, Ronald Reagan was in office. I'm not sure how familiar you are with Reagan's presidency, but around that time is when the Iran-Contra scandal started to break. Now sixteen-year-old me was naturally caught up in the counterculture of the era, which meant that I saw Reagan as the hypocrite that history now knows him to be.

I was eighteen when I voted for Dukakis. Bush won the election after Reagan's second term ended. That was about when I realized that the country simply didn't care.

And now I look around and see people worshiping Reagan as if he was some sort of deity...and then they put another Bush in office.

Dispicable.

 

What am I trying to say here? I'm trying to say that if this country elected a Bush three times, a republican after Reagan, and called for Clinton's head, there's nothing that Obama could do to surprise me. It isn't a shit-throwing fest; it's a war of words. It's show business. Each and every politician is a pawn who wants to get promoted to a queen. Some of them become rooks, some of them become knights, some of them never get promoted at all. And in the end, all any of them ever do is put on a great performance in the hopes that you'll buy into it. That's all politics has ever been, since Roman times, and it isn't changing anytime soon.

But don't let that push you out of it. There ARE good apples in the bunch - they just don't have enough funding to buy 30-seconds of Super Bowl primetime advertisement like everyone else does. Yes, the system is rigged. Yes, Citizens United probably made it impossible for a poor person to ever get elected. Yes, the Koch brothers bankroll both parties.

But so what? There's independents out there, they just need votes. The most dangerous thing you can do to your country is say that you don't care, or that it isn't worth it. With some exceptions everybody's vote counts, so get out there and say something. Your representative isn't answering his phone? Write him a letter. Doesn't read your letters? Nail it do his mailbox if you have to. That doesn't work? Put your name on the goddamn ballot if have to - I've seen many people do this when they feel they have no other way to get their voice heard, and you'd be surprised how often it works. And never, ever, ever say it isn't worth it. We did not revolt from the British crown just so our populace could stop caring.
